Charlie is off to Hampshire to meet Nikki and Darren, who have struck gold with their stunning seaside plot.
While in the hospital recovering from an emergency appendectomy, Todd is convinced he overheard a plot to murder someone.

This week the family go to Hawaii.. Chris embarks on a treasure hunt, Miguel cooks up some delicious Hawaiian LauLau, Amanda embarks on a Jurassic adventure and the team explore the sights of Waikiki.

Join our expert panel for team news, analysis and build-up as we set the scene ahead of kick-off.

The NCIS, FBI, and MI6 teams continue the international manhunt for an escaped British spy who's targeting current and former agents. Anthony DiNozzo bids farewell to NCIS.
The Fugitive Task Force races to catch the culprit threatening Manhattan with a dirty bomb. Meanwhile, Ray prepares to celebrate a major life milestone as his wedding to Cora approaches.
The team, with the help of their new intel analyst, Special Agent Amanda Tate, work to clean up the pieces left behind after a massive explosion rocks headquarters and their key suspect slips away.
When a Corporal is taken prisoner in Iraq, Harm and Meg are assigned to act as the Corporal's lawyers as well as attempt to free him from captivity.
Meg goes undercover as a Marine recruit in order to investigate the mysterious death of a female private in a boot camp.
